rules.rule: Require the exact source_head and contract_id; no newer or unknown source accepted implicitly.
Exactly the 197 unique known tensor IDs, shapes, logical axes and precisions below for the synthetic known-subset profile; not a complete player-model inventory.
Reject extra Wk/query-key biases/D0-R Wh,bh in this profile. Additional source tensors cannot be inferred from tensor count.

Prepared learned tensor elements and stage/window scalars must be finite. This is a conservative synthetic preparation policy; original stored-model inventory and full checks require page 56. Runtime intermediates may overflow.
Require 32 distinct ra/m values, five decoder f values, ten distinct global symbols, exact f16 encodings. No default, inferred negative bound or duplicated per-stage copy of a global symbol.
Two parity blocks, each containing the eleven named stage/level rows exactly once. Each xy component is 0,2,4,6. Dk-R derives each component (s+4)%8 from Dk; do not accept independent recurrent rows.

Require finite ordered A_CLAMPn <= A_CLAMP and ACT_CLn <= ACT_CL, preventing vacuous attention validation. Lower endpoints remain independent symbols. Original full symbol-domain validation is not established.
For every binary16 c in inclusive [A_CLAMPn,A_CLAMP], evaluate p=R(c*R(A_P1-c*c)+A_P0), y=32*(p-1); reject unless 1<=y<31. Products within each R are exact; no extra rounding.
Compute w=2^(floor(y)-15)*(1+y-floor(y)); record max w and boolean 64*max(w)>=65520. A true record alone must not reject.

h0,h1 are finite stored f16, widened exactly; e0=correctly-rounded-f32-exp(h0), s2=correctly-rounded-f32-exp(h1), s1=min(e0,S1CAP). s2 nonfinite rejects. h0 overflow is allowed if cap produces finite s1; s2=0 from underflow is not prohibited.

Synthetic profile requires explicitly supplied finite f32 S1CAP and finite s1/s2. This cap dtype/domain is solely our synthetic input convention; page 57 original dtype/domain is unknown. Require derived f32 bits to match both prepared head tensors.
Nine X_ values must be finite f32 zero or normal; X_LMAX>=0, X_KEY>0, X_MFL>0, X_EFL>0, X_CLn<=X_CL, exact-real X_KEY/X_MFL<65520. No sign bound is supplied for X_LWrb,X_LWg,X_NRM.

The declared X domain does not prove E_raw positive, its f16 rounding finite, or X3 finite. Counterexamples are in synthetic-cases.json. Report declared-domain result separately from derived operational hazards; do not silently amend the source domain or claim source-wide conformance.
When the worker expands a recipe, require exactly product(shape) elements and the specified dtype. Never accept a descriptor or recipe as validation of a real allocation.
Reject physical offsets, strides, source permutations, container/build IDs, source paths, signatures or learned payloads in this values-free interchange; logical axis order is not serialized order.
Complete player-model admission is always blocked under this version, even if every known descriptor and all synthetic validation checks pass. Unknown frontend/model mapping cannot be defaulted.
